def dif_Square(n):
    """
    Check if the given number can be represented as the difference of two squares.
    
    :param n: Integer to check
    :return: Boolean indicating whether the number can be represented as the difference of two squares
    """
    if n % 4 == 0 or n % 2 == 1:
        return True
    else:
        return False
